title: CSRP：基于强化学习和效率感知奖励的中文文本纠错链式推理
summary: 提出CSRP三阶段框架，通过持续预训练、链式思维监督微调和基于效率感知奖励的强化学习，解决中文语法纠错中的过度纠正问题。在NACGEC基准上达到50.99 F0.5和57.17精确率，拼写纠正F1达59.61，超越GPT-4。
summary_en: Proposes CSRP, a three-stage framework combining continual pre-training, chain-of-thought SFT, and reinforcement learning with efficiency-aware rewards to address over-correction in Chinese grammatical error correction. Achieves 50.99 F0.5 and 57.17 precision on NACGEC, and 59.61 F1 on spelling correction, surpassing GPT-4.
